status_summary: No commission on the Fed's mission, alternatives to the Fed or the financial regulatory structure was found, by statute or executive action. On 2026-07-09 the Fed announced five task forces of outside advisers (communications, balance sheet policy, data, productivity and jobs, inflation frameworks) that produce findings for the FOMC; they are internal to the Fed and do not examine alternatives to it or the regulatory apparatus. S. 3476, the Fed Forward Act of 2025, introduced 2025-12-15, would require the Board to review its monetary policy framework every five years but creates no commission.

timeline.event: S. 3476, the Fed Forward Act of 2025, was introduced and referred to the Senate Banking Committee; it would require a Board review of the monetary policy framework every five years and creates no commission.

The Fed announced five advisory task forces led by outside advisers (communications, balance sheet policy, data, productivity and jobs, inflation frameworks) to report to the FOMC; they are internal to the Fed and not a commission on its mission or alternatives.

title: Appoint a commission on the Fed's mission, alternatives to it, and financial regulation
uncertainties: The Treasury Secretary's July 2025 television call to examine the whole Federal Reserve is a statement, not an event; the Treasury conference remarks listed as a source did not mention such a review. Centennial Monetary Commission bills were found only from the 113th and 114th Congresses; two searches for a 119th Congress counterpart found none, and congress.gov search could not be fetched, so absence is not proven. H.R. 2418, the Federal Reserve Regulatory Oversight Act (introduced 2025-03-27), would put the Board's non-monetary functions under appropriations and is not a commission. The task forces and S. 3476 are listed as context and do not count toward the stage.
